name: Pixoguess
storyline: Every image has a story, but can you recognize it before it’s too late? In Pixoguess, mysterious pixelated pictures slowly reveal themselves one piece at a time. Keep your eyes sharp, trust your instincts, and be the first to uncover what’s hiding behind the pixels. From familiar faces and iconic characters to games, movies, logos, and countless other subjects, every round puts your recognition skills to the test. The faster you figure it out, the more points you earn!
summary: Pixoguess is a web-based multiplayer game where players are presented with pixelated images that gradually become clearer. The objective is to be the first to recognize and correctly guess the image. Players can create private lobbies to play with friends or join public games. The game offers various categories and is designed to be quick and engaging, making it perfect for parties and casual gaming sessions.
